listTool.description: List all available monster status, optionally filtering by title. All titles are in the format 'level-1-2' where the level range is always only two levels starting with an even number and going from levels-1-2 and going to levels-29-30.

defaultTool.description: Get the monster stats content for a given title. All titles are in the format 'level-1-2' where the level range is always only two levels starting with an even number and going from levels-1-2 and going to levels-29-30.
